mapper.select: SELECT A.BOOKSET_ID as booksetId, A.HAPPEN_DATE as happenDate, A.BOOK_DATE as bookDate, C.BOOKSET_DATE as booksetDate, B.STANDARD_CCY as standardCcy, A.TASK_ID as taskId, D.BUSI_ID as finprodId, D.BUSI_DETAIL_TYPE as finprodType, D.BRANCH as branch, D.BOK_DETAIL_ID as bokDetailId, D.LAYERING_ID as layeringId FROM BOK_BATCH_TASK_TODO A INNER JOIN BOK_BOOKSET B ON B.BOOKSET_ID = A.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_DATE C ON C.BOOKSET_ID = A.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_ACCT_LAYERING_INFO D ON D.BUSI_ID = B.BOOKSET_ID AND D.BUSI_DETAIL_TYPE = B.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE WHERE A.SEQ_NO = #{seqNo} AND A.BOOKSET_DATE = #{BOOKSET_DATE} AND A.BOOK_DATE = #{BOOK_DATE} AND A.HAPPEN_DATE = #{HAPPEN_DATE} AND A.TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND B.ACCT_MODE = #{acctMode} AND B.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE = #{acctSubjectType} AND A.IS_SUB_BOOKSET = #{IS_SUB_BOOKSET}
